description.narrative: Building the local community's capacity to face disasters through specialized training courses, strengthening preparedness and early response, contributing to protecting individuals and reducing damage, and raising the efficiency of local staff in crisis management.

Transfer knowledge through a number of specialized courses. Strengthen capacities for preparedness and early readiness to face disasters. Enhance the safety of individuals and the community and reduce the impact of disasters. Raise the efficiency and readiness of the country's local staff to face disasters and reduce their effects.
